glosses: bushes, thicket, brush, scrub, copse (densely vegetated area with mainly smaller plants and some trees)
boondocks, the middle of nowhere; a remote, rural area

examples.text: Kannst du mir beim Pflanzen dieses Busches helfen?
examples.en: Can you help me plant this shrub?

examples.text: Wir fanden die gestohlene Tasche in diesem Busch.
examples.en: We found the stolen bag in this bush.

examples.text: Tom versteckte sich hinter einem Busch.
examples.en: Tom was hiding behind a bush.
